tasks.title: Answers inside groups
tasks.acceptance: `/ask` or @mention in a group answers only from that same group's live passages; never cites other groups (C02). Redirect stays for DM-only commands.

tasks.title: Already-answered hints
tasks.acceptance: Per-group admin opt-in. When a new help_request matches an earlier answered question in the same group (coverage >= 0.6 and replies > 0), reply once with a link to the earlier thread. Max 1 hint per question, rate-limited per group.

tasks.title: Unanswered-question routing
tasks.acceptance: Help request with no reply after N hours (default 4): privately DM at most 2 opted-in, available experts with matching skills who can read that group, with a link only. Respects the expert weekly cap and a per-expert daily cap. Experts can turn it off.

tasks.title: Russian / English bot interface
tasks.acceptance: All bot texts in RU and EN, chosen from Telegram language_code with a /language override. Tests assert every message key exists in both locales.

tasks.title: Answer feedback
tasks.acceptance: Helpful / not helpful / wrong-citation buttons on /ask results; aggregate per passage only; boosts rank of helpful passages; no public personal judgements.

tasks.title: /catchup on demand
tasks.acceptance: Digest-style summary of the member's readable groups since a chosen time (default: last visit), reusing digest.build; rate-limited.

tasks.title: Canonical answers
tasks.acceptance: Admin replies /canonical to a message: it ranks first for its topic; marking a newer one labels the old one outdated (supersedes link).

tasks.title: Search filters
tasks.acceptance: `/ask in:<group> since:<date> has:file` parsed before FTS; filters narrow the readable set, never widen it.

tasks.title: Private skill suggestions
tasks.acceptance: After a member gives several replies on a skill topic, privately suggest adding it; nothing is stored as confirmed unless they accept.

tasks.title: Events list
tasks.acceptance: Detect event announcements; /events lists upcoming ones with links and an .ics file; moderators can hide false positives.

tasks.title: Telegram Mini App
tasks.acceptance: Web app served by the Worker (static assets) for search, profile, requests and settings; identity from Telegram's signed initData, verified server-side; no new data collection.
